chunks.text:
1. Purpose Of This Endorsement
This endorsement revises clause 3.2 of SecurePlus Family Health Policy v2.0 following IRDAI circular IRDAI/HLT/MISC/CIR/089/2026 on standardisation of maternity benefits. All other clauses of v2.0 remain unchanged.
chunks.title: Endorsement E01 Maternity Waiting Period Revision

chunks.text:
2. Revised Maternity Cover
Maternity expenses are covered up to Rs 75,000 for normal delivery and Rs 100,000 for caesarean section, subject to a reduced continuous waiting period of 24 months from first enrollment. The earlier waiting period of 36 months stands superseded for policies issued or renewed on or after the effective date.
chunks.title: Endorsement E01 Maternity Waiting Period Revision

chunks.text:
2.1 Newborn Cover From Day One
The newborn baby is covered from birth under the family floater without additional premium until the next renewal, when the child must be added to the schedule.
chunks.title: Endorsement E01 Maternity Waiting Period Revision

chunks.text:
2.2 Pre And Post Natal Expenses
Pre-natal expenses up to Rs 10,000 and post-natal expenses up to Rs 15,000 incurred within 90 days of delivery are admissible within the maternity limits stated above.
chunks.title: Endorsement E01 Maternity Waiting Period Revision

chunks.text:
3. Applicability And Transition
For in-force policies renewed on or after the effective date, the reduced waiting period applies prospectively from renewal date and completed waiting time under v2.0 counts toward the 24-month requirement. No retrospective reopening of settled claims arises from this revision.
chunks.title: Endorsement E01 Maternity Waiting Period Revision

chunks.text:
1. Purpose Of This Endorsement
This endorsement revises the vehicle age eligibility and claim limits for the Zero Depreciation add-on under DriveCare Motor Package Policy v2.4, aligning with revised tariff filings.
chunks.title: Endorsement E02 Zero Depreciation Eligibility Revision

chunks.text:
2. Revised Eligibility
The Zero Depreciation add-on is available for private cars up to 5 years of vehicle age at first purchase of the add-on. Continuation is permitted up to 7 years for renewals without break; beyond 7 years the add-on lapses and standard depreciation applies.
chunks.title: Endorsement E02 Zero Depreciation Eligibility Revision

chunks.text:
3. Revised Claim Limit
A maximum of two zero depreciation claims are admissible per policy year combined across all vehicles on the schedule. From the third claim onward, parts depreciation applies per Annexure M of the base policy.
chunks.title: Endorsement E02 Zero Depreciation Eligibility Revision

chunks.text:
4. Premium Loading For High Risk Localities
Vehicles garaged in postal codes listed in the high-theft zone annexure attract a 10 percent loading on the zero depreciation premium component. The loading is disclosed in the quotation before payment.
chunks.title: Endorsement E02 Zero Depreciation Eligibility Revision

chunks.text:
1. What Happens If I Miss My Health Policy Renewal Date
A grace period of 30 days applies after the due date during which continuity of cover is preserved but no new claims arising in the gap window are payable for illnesses contracted during the break. Beyond 30 days the policy lapses and fresh underwriting with fresh waiting periods applies.
chunks.title: FAQ Renewals Endorsements And Portability

chunks.text:
2. How Does No Claim Bonus Work When I Switch Motor Insurers
Your accrued No Claim Bonus belongs to you as the insured person, not to the vehicle sale alone. Present the renewal notice or NCB certificate from your previous insurer to receive the equivalent NCB slab with the new insurer at porting.
chunks.title: FAQ Renewals Endorsements And Portability

chunks.text:
3. Can I Add A Newborn Baby To My Family Health Policy
Yes. The newborn is covered from day one under SecurePlus v2.1 until the next renewal without additional premium; at renewal add the child to the schedule with name and date of birth to continue cover.
chunks.title: FAQ Renewals Endorsements And Portability

chunks.text:
4. How Do I Transfer Vehicle Insurance To The Buyer Of My Car
Hand over the policy and apply for a ownership transfer endorsement within 14 days of sale using Form 29 and Form 30 copies. Your No Claim Bonus stays with you and can be used on your next vehicle within 90 days.
chunks.title: FAQ Renewals Endorsements And Portability

chunks.text:
5. What Documents Are Needed For A Cashless Hospital Admission
Provide the health policy number or e-card, photo identity proof and the hospital admission note. For planned admissions request pre-authorisation at least 48 hours before admission through the network hospital insurance desk.
chunks.title: FAQ Renewals Endorsements And Portability

chunks.text:
6. Is My Premium Refunded If I Cancel During The Free Look Period
Health policies carry a 15-day free look period from receipt of the document. Cancellation within free look refunds the premium less proportionate risk cover for the days on risk, medical check-up costs and stamp duty where applicable.
chunks.title: FAQ Renewals Endorsements And Portability

chunks.text:
7. How Long Does A Reimbursement Claim Take To Settle
Reimbursement claims are settled within 30 days of receiving complete documentation per clause 7.1 of SecurePlus v2.1. Incomplete documents pause the clock until the missing items are provided.
chunks.title: FAQ Renewals Endorsements And Portability

chunks.text:
1. Scope Of Cover
This indemnity policy covers inpatient hospitalisation, day-care procedures listed in Annexure A, pre and post hospitalisation expenses for 60 and 90 days respectively, and emergency ambulance charges up to Rs 2,000 per hospitalisation for the insured persons named in the schedule.
chunks.title: SecurePlus Family Health Policy

chunks.text:
1.1 Sum Insured Options
Sum insured options are Rs 5 lakh, Rs 10 lakh, Rs 25 lakh, Rs 50 lakh and Rs 1 crore per family per policy year on a family floater basis.
chunks.title: SecurePlus Family Health Policy

chunks.text:
1.2 Restoration Benefit
On complete or partial utilisation of the sum insured in a policy year, the sum insured is restored once without additional premium for subsequent claims in the same year. Restoration does not apply to claims for the same illness for which the earlier claim was made.
chunks.title: SecurePlus Family Health Policy

chunks.text:
2. Eligibility And Entry Age
Adults aged 18 to 65 years may enrol as proposers; dependent children are covered from 91 days to 25 years if financially independent education is continuing. Renewal is lifelong provided continuity of cover is maintained without a break exceeding 30 days.
chunks.title: SecurePlus Family Health Policy

chunks.text:
3. Waiting Periods
A continuous waiting period of 30 days applies from the commencement date for all illnesses except accidents. Specified procedures listed in Annexure B carry a 24-month waiting period.
chunks.title: SecurePlus Family Health Policy

chunks.text:
3.1 Pre-Existing Diseases
Pre-existing diseases are covered after a continuous waiting period of 36 months of first enrollment, provided premiums are paid when due and no material misstatement was made in the proposal form.
chunks.title: SecurePlus Family Health Policy

chunks.text:
3.2 Maternity And Newborn Cover
Maternity expenses are covered up to Rs 75,000 for normal delivery and Rs 100,000 for caesarean section, subject to a 24-month continuous waiting period. The newborn baby is covered from day one under the family floater without additional premium for the remainder of the policy year.
chunks.title: SecurePlus Family Health Policy

chunks.text:
4. Exclusions
This policy does not cover expenses arising from or attributable to non-medical items as per Annexure C, cosmetic or aesthetic treatments unless medically necessary following accident or cancer, dental treatment unless requiring hospitalisation, experimental or unproven treatments, treatment outside the geographical limits of India unless the overseas treatment rider is purchased, self-inflicted injury or attempted suicide, participation in hazardous sports, war and nuclear perils, and treatment for alcohol or substance abuse.
chunks.title: SecurePlus Family Health Policy

chunks.text:
4.1 Specific Disease Exclusions
No cover is admissible for internal congenital conditions existing before entry, HIV and AIDS related treatments, and infertility treatments including IVF and surcharge procedures.
chunks.title: SecurePlus Family Health Policy

chunks.text:
5. Co-Payment And Room Rent Limits
A co-payment of 10 percent applies to all claims for insured persons aged 61 years and above at the time of admission. Room rent is payable up to single private room category; associated procedure costs are proportionately reduced if a higher category room is chosen.
chunks.title: SecurePlus Family Health Policy

chunks.text:
6. Cashless Network
Cashless facility is available only at network hospitals listed in the current empanelment directory published quarterly by the insurer. For planned admissions, intimation must be given at least 48 hours before hospitalisation; for emergencies, within 24 hours of admission.
chunks.title: SecurePlus Family Health Policy

chunks.text:
7. Claims Procedure
Claims must be intimated through the claims helpline or portal with policy number, patient details and hospital information. Documents required include discharge summary, original bills, prescriptions, diagnostic reports and KYC of the proposer.
chunks.title: SecurePlus Family Health Policy

chunks.text:
7.1 Claim Decision Timeline
Cashless claims receive a decision within 2 hours of the final authorisation request for emergencies and within 6 working hours for planned admissions. Reimbursement claims are settled within 30 days of receipt of complete documentation.
chunks.title: SecurePlus Family Health Policy

chunks.text:
8. Premium Loading And Revision
Premium rates are guaranteed for the first policy year only. At renewal the insurer may revise premiums across age bands with prior approval of the Authority and 90 days notice to the insured. A no-claim bonus of 10 percent of sum insured per claim-free year accrues up to a maximum of 50 percent.
chunks.title: SecurePlus Family Health Policy

chunks.text:
9. Portability And Continuity
Portability requests under applicable regulations are accepted at least 45 days before renewal, with credit for accrued waiting periods when the portability declaration is verified.
chunks.title: SecurePlus Family Health Policy

chunks.text:
10. Grievance Redressal
Grievances are first addressed by the servicing branch within 15 days. Unresolved grievances may be escalated to the Insurance Ombudsman under the applicable redressal scheme. This clause is procedural and does not extend coverage.
chunks.title: SecurePlus Family Health Policy

chunks.text:
1. Scope Of Cover
This pure protection term plan pays the Sum Assured to the nominee upon death of the life assured during the policy term, provided the policy is in force on the date of death. No maturity benefit is payable if the life assured survives the term.
chunks.title: Pol Lifeshield Term

chunks.text:
2. Eligibility And Sum Assured
Entry age is 18 to 60 years; policy term ranges from 10 to 40 years subject to a maximum maturity age of 75 years. Minimum sum assured is Rs 25 lakh with no maximum beyond underwriting limits based on income justification.
chunks.title: Pol Lifeshield Term

chunks.text:
3. Waiting And Contestability Periods
Death claims arising from suicide within the first 12 months of commencement are not admissible; premiums paid are refunded. The insurer may contest misstatements of medical or smoking history for 3 years from commencement after which the policy becomes non-contestable except for proven fraud.
chunks.title: Pol Lifeshield Term

chunks.text:
4. Exclusions
The policy does not pay death benefit where death results directly or indirectly from suicide within 12 months as stated above, from participation in criminal acts, from aviation other than travel as a fare-paying passenger on a licensed commercial flight, from hazardous sports including racing, mountaineering and scuba diving unless declared and accepted at underwriting.
chunks.title: Pol Lifeshield Term

chunks.text:
5. Riders
Optional riders available are Accidental Death Benefit Rider up to Rs 1 crore and Critical Illness Rider covering 37 listed conditions. Riders terminate automatically when base premium ceases or on payment of the terminal illness claim.
chunks.title: Pol Lifeshield Term

chunks.text:
6. Grace Period Revival And Lapse
A grace period of 30 days applies for annual mode and 15 days for monthly mode. Lapsed policies may be revived within 2 years of first unpaid premium subject to declaration of insurability and payment of arrears with interest per the revival schedule.
chunks.title: Pol Lifeshield Term

chunks.text:
7. Free Look Period
A free look period of 30 days applies from receipt of the policy document. Cancellation within free look refunds premium less proportionate risk premium, medical examination costs and stamp duty.
chunks.title: Pol Lifeshield Term

chunks.text:
8. Nomination And Assignment
Nomination under applicable law is permitted at inception or later by endorsement. Assignment transfers beneficial interest and requires written notice in the prescribed form.
chunks.title: Pol Lifeshield Term

chunks.text:
9. Tax Treatment
Premiums and benefits receive treatment per prevailing tax laws which may change; tax benefits are not guaranteed and depend on statutory provisions in force in the relevant year.
chunks.title: Pol Lifeshield Term

chunks.text:
1.1 Investment Objective
The primary objective is to generate long-term capital appreciation through investments in equity and equity-related securities while maintaining exposure to fixed-income instruments to manage portfolio volatility.
chunks.title: GrowthPlus Balanced Advantage Fund Policy

chunks.text:
1.2 Asset Allocation
The portfolio may maintain equity and equity-related exposure between 30 percent and 80 percent of the portfolio. Fixed-income and money-market instruments may comprise between 20 percent and 70 percent. The allocation may vary within these limits based on the fund's investment strategy and prevailing market conditions.
chunks.title: GrowthPlus Balanced Advantage Fund Policy

chunks.text:
1.3 Minimum Investment
The minimum initial investment is Rs 5,000. Additional investments may be made in multiples of Rs 1,000. Systematic Investment Plans may be started with a minimum monthly contribution of Rs 500.

Eligibility
Resident individual investors, Hindu Undivided Families, trusts, companies and other eligible entities permitted under applicable regulations may invest subject to completion of applicable KYC and account-opening requirements. Minors may invest through a legally appointed guardian where permitted.
chunks.title: GrowthPlus Balanced Advantage Fund Policy

chunks.text:
2.1 Risk Profile
This product is intended primarily for investors with moderate to moderately high risk tolerance and a medium-to-long investment horizon. It may not be appropriate for investors seeking guaranteed returns, capital protection or short-term liquidity.
chunks.title: GrowthPlus Balanced Advantage Fund Policy

chunks.text:
2.2 Recommended Investment Horizon
A minimum investment horizon of 5 years is recommended. Investors with a horizon of less than 3 years should generally consider whether market-linked exposure is appropriate for their financial objective and liquidity requirements.

Return And Market Risk
Returns are market-linked and depend on the performance of the underlying securities. Past performance does not guarantee future results. The value of investments may increase or decrease depending on equity-market movements, interest-rate changes, credit events, economic conditions and other market factors.
chunks.title: GrowthPlus Balanced Advantage Fund Policy

chunks.text:
3.1 Capital Loss Risk
The investor may receive less than the amount originally invested. The product does not guarantee preservation of capital.
chunks.title: GrowthPlus Balanced Advantage Fund Policy

chunks.text:
3.2 Volatility
Equity exposure can result in significant short-term fluctuations. The fixed-income component may reduce portfolio volatility but does not eliminate investment risk.

Liquidity And Redemption
Investors may submit redemption requests on applicable business days subject to the fund's operational procedures. Redemption proceeds are normally paid within the settlement period prescribed under applicable regulations.
chunks.title: GrowthPlus Balanced Advantage Fund Policy

chunks.text:
4.1 Exit Load
A 1 percent exit load may apply to units redeemed within 12 months from the date of investment. No exit load applies after the applicable holding period, subject to the scheme's current terms.
chunks.title: GrowthPlus Balanced Advantage Fund Policy

chunks.text:
4.2  Systematic Withdrawal
Eligible investors may register a systematic withdrawal instruction subject to minimum withdrawal amounts and applicable scheme conditions. Systematic withdrawals may reduce the invested capital over time. Taxation
Tax treatment depends on applicable tax laws, the investor's circumstances, the nature and duration of the investment and prevailing regulations. Investors should consult an appropriately qualified tax professional for individual tax advice. Fees And Expenses
The fund may charge management fees, operating expenses and other permitted expenses within applicable regulatory limits. The applicable expense ratio and other charges must be disclosed to investors through the current product documentation before investment.
chunks.title: GrowthPlus Balanced Advantage Fund Policy

chunks.text:
4.2 Suitability Requirements
This product may be considered where the customer has a medium-to-long-term financial goal, accepts market fluctuations and has a moderate or higher risk tolerance.
chunks.title: GrowthPlus Balanced Advantage Fund Policy

chunks.text:
7.1 Suitable Customer Profiles
The product may be suitable for customers seeking long-term wealth accumulation, retirement corpus growth, children's future education funding or other goals with an investment horizon of at least 5 years.
chunks.title: GrowthPlus Balanced Advantage Fund Policy

chunks.text:
7.2 Unsuitable Customer Profiles
The product should generally not be recommended where the customer requires guaranteed returns, has a very low risk tolerance, requires the invested funds for immediate expenses or has a short-term investment horizon.
chunks.title: GrowthPlus Balanced Advantage Fund Policy

chunks.text:
7.3 Emergency Fund Restriction
The product should not be recommended as a substitute for an emergency fund. Customers should maintain adequate liquid savings for near-term financial obligations before considering market-linked investments.

Recommendation Controls
A recommendation may be generated only after the customer's risk profile, investment horizon, stated financial goal, liquidity requirements and product eligibility have been assessed.
chunks.title: GrowthPlus Balanced Advantage Fund Policy

chunks.text:
8.1 Mandatory Suitability Checks
The recommendation engine must verify:

Customer risk tolerance is compatible with the product risk level.
Investment horizon is consistent with the recommended minimum horizon.
Customer does not require guaranteed capital protection.
Investment amount does not conflict with identified liquidity requirements.
Required KYC and eligibility information is available.
No existing portfolio concentration creates an inappropriate additional exposure.
chunks.title: GrowthPlus Balanced Advantage Fund Policy

chunks.text:
8.2  Risk Mismatch
If the customer's assessed risk tolerance is lower than the product's permitted risk category, the product must not be presented as a recommended investment. The assistant should explain the mismatch and provide lower-risk alternatives where available. Mis-Selling Prevention
The product must not be recommended solely because of historical returns, promotional campaigns, sales targets, commissions or customer similarity to other investors. The assistant must not state or imply that:

Returns are guaranteed. Capital cannot be lost. Past performance will continue. The product is suitable for every investor. The product is risk-free. The customer must invest immediately. Explainability Requirements
Every personalized recommendation must explain why the product may or may not align with the customer's stated goal, risk tolerance and investment horizon.
chunks.title: GrowthPlus Balanced Advantage Fund Policy

chunks.text:
8.2 The explanation must include relevant benefits, material risks, liquidity considerations and at least one reasonable alternative where the recommendation could expose the customer to meaningful risk. Human Review And Escalation
Human advisor review is required when customer information is incomplete or contradictory, the customer's risk profile conflicts with the proposed investment, the proposed investment creates significant portfolio concentration, the customer requests a return guarantee, or the recommendation involves an exception to standard suitability rules. Customer Disclosure
Before investment, the customer must be informed that the product is market-linked, returns are not guaranteed, the value of investments can fall, and the investor may lose part or all of the invested capital depending on market performance.
chunks.title: GrowthPlus Balanced Advantage Fund Policy

chunks.text:
8.2 Product Information Validity
The recommendation engine must retrieve the latest approved product documentation before generating product-specific recommendations. Superseded product documents must not be used for active recommendations. Monitoring And Review
Product suitability rules, risk classifications, fees, investment limits and other material product characteristics must be reviewed periodically by the designated investment product and compliance teams. Any material change to the product must trigger review of existing recommendation rules and associated RAG knowledge sources. Advisory Limitation
This policy governs a personalized, non-binding financial guidance capability. A recommendation generated by the assistant does not constitute a guarantee of investment performance or replace the judgment of an appropriately qualified financial advisor.
chunks.title: GrowthPlus Balanced Advantage Fund Policy

chunks.text:
1. Scope Of Cover
This package policy covers loss of or damage to the insured vehicle described in the schedule, liability towards third parties for bodily injury and property damage as required by the Motors Vehicles Act, and personal accident cover for the owner-driver as per Section 3.
chunks.title: DriveCare Motor Package Policy

chunks.text:
1.1 Own Damage Cover
Own damage cover applies to the insured vehicle against fire, explosion, self-ignition, burglary, housebreaking, riot, strike, malicious act, terrorist activity, earthquake, flood, typhoon, inundation, landslide, rockslide, and accidental external means.
chunks.title: DriveCare Motor Package Policy

chunks.text:
1.2 Third Party Liability
Liability for third party death or bodily injury is unlimited as per judicial awards; third party property damage is covered up to Rs 7.5 lakh for private cars. Third party claims are adjudicated by the Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal and are not decided by the insurer alone.
chunks.title: DriveCare Motor Package Policy

chunks.text:
2. Insured Declared Value
Insured Declared Value is the manufacturer listed ex-showroom price of the vehicle less depreciation as per the schedule in Annexure M. IDV is fixed at inception and renewal and directly caps own damage claim settlement.
chunks.title: DriveCare Motor Package Policy

chunks.text:
3. Depreciation Schedule
Depreciation for parts in own damage claims applies as follows: zero depreciation for rubber nylon plastic parts tyres tubes batteries airbags for vehicles up to 5 years where the zero depreciation add-on is purchased; otherwise fibre glass components 30 percent, and mechanical electrical parts depreciate per age band table in Annexure M.
chunks.title: DriveCare Motor Package Policy

chunks.text:
4. Add-On Covers
Optional add-ons available at additional premium are Zero Depreciation, Engine Protect, Roadside Assistance, Return To Invoice, Consumables Cover, and No Claim Bonus Protection. Add-ons apply only if the corresponding endorsement appears in the policy schedule.
chunks.title: DriveCare Motor Package Policy

chunks.text:
4.1 Zero Depreciation Add-On
Zero Depreciation add-on waives parts depreciation for own damage claims for vehicles up to 5 vehicle age. A maximum of two zero depreciation claims are admissible per policy year; thereafter standard depreciation applies.
chunks.title: DriveCare Motor Package Policy

chunks.text:
5. No Claim Bonus
No Claim Bonus accrues at 20 percent for the first claim-free year, 25 percent for two, 30 percent for three, 35 percent for four and 50 percent from five consecutive claim-free years. NCB follows the insured person on porting to another insurer and is forfeited upon any own damage claim in the expiring policy period.
chunks.title: DriveCare Motor Package Policy

chunks.text:
6. Exclusions
This policy does not cover consequential loss, wear and tear, mechanical or electrical breakdown failure, tyres and tubes unless damaged concurrently with the vehicle, vehicles used outside the permitted usage declared in the proposal, driving without a valid licence, driving under the influence of alcohol or intoxicants, use for speed testing racing reliability trial, war perils, and vehicles carrying goods beyond permitted capacity.
chunks.title: DriveCare Motor Package Policy

chunks.text:
7. Claims Procedure
Accident claims require immediate intimation to the insurer and police FIR for theft, third party injury or fatal accidents. A surveyor inspection is mandated before repair for own damage claims above Rs 50,000; photographs-based digital survey may be allowed below this threshold at the insurer's discretion.
chunks.title: DriveCare Motor Package Policy

chunks.text:
7.1 Cashless Repair Network
Repairs at network garages proceed cashless upon surveyor approval; repairs at non-network garages are reimbursed based on assessed amount less excess and depreciation.
chunks.title: DriveCare Motor Package Policy

chunks.text:
8. Voluntary Deductible And Compulsory Excess
A compulsory excess applies per the tariff for claims involving aged drivers or specific vehicle classes. A voluntary deductible chosen at inception earns a premium discount per the rate card and is deducted from each own damage claim settlement.
chunks.title: DriveCare Motor Package Policy

chunks.text:
9. Transfer Of Ownership
Ownership transfer requires endorsement within 14 days of vehicle sale with Form 29 and 30 copies. NCB earned by the seller does not transfer to the buyer; the buyer may earn NCB afresh from the following renewal.
chunks.title: DriveCare Motor Package Policy

chunks.text:
10. Renewal Inspection
Break in coverage beyond 90 days requires fresh vehicle inspection before renewal and results in loss of accrued No Claim Bonus and re-imposition of waiting periods applicable to add-on covers.
chunks.title: DriveCare Motor Package Policy

chunks.text:
1. Purpose
This standard operating procedure governs how service teams and underwriters interpret policy wordings, resolve conflicts between documents, and escalate ambiguous cases. It applies to all health, motor and life product lines handled by the underwriting helpdesk.
chunks.title: SOP Underwriter Escalation And Interpretation Protocol

chunks.text:
2. Order Of Precedence For Interpretation
Where documents conflict, interpretation follows this order: regulatory circulars of the Authority override all internal documents; current endorsements override the base policy wording; later-dated clauses override earlier versions of the same clause; explicit exclusions are construed narrowly against the insurer per established interpretation norms.
chunks.title: SOP Underwriter Escalation And Interpretation Protocol

chunks.text:
3. Mandatory Escalation Triggers
A query must be escalated to a senior underwriter when any of the following applies: retrieved clauses do not answer the question with sufficient completeness; two retrieved clauses give materially different answers; the queried document is past its review window and no superseding endorsement exists; the question asks for a legal opinion or litigation strategy; the question concerns an ongoing claim dispute.
chunks.title: SOP Underwriter Escalation And Interpretation Protocol

chunks.text:
4. Response Documentation Requirements
Every escalated case must record the question, retrieved clause references with versions, the reason for escalation, and the senior underwriter decision reference number in the underwriting log within 24 hours.
chunks.title: SOP Underwriter Escalation And Interpretation Protocol

chunks.text:
5. Service Timeline
Escalations are acknowledged within 4 business hours and resolved within 24 business hours. Cases pending beyond 72 hours are reported to the Chief Underwriting Officer weekly.
chunks.title: SOP Underwriter Escalation And Interpretation Protocol

chunks.text:
6. Prohibited Interpretations
Staff must never provide interpretations that guarantee claim settlement outcomes, waive exclusions without a documented endorsement, or advise customers on litigation positions. Such requests are refused and routed to the compliance team.
chunks.title: SOP Underwriter Escalation And Interpretation Protocol
